# Pravesh Computer Services

> Laptop and computer repair shop at Sanjay Place, Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. Shop repairs and technician home visits (subject to availability) for laptops and desktops. Customers are also served from Mathura, Firozabad, Bharatpur, Etmadpur, Fatehabad and Hathras.

## Business facts
- Name: Pravesh Computer Services
- Address: 39/G-106, Sky Tower, Sanjay Place, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282002, India
- Phone: +91 75799 96887 (alternate +91 75340 21831)
- Services: laptop screen replacement, motherboard and charging-fault repair, keyboard and hinge repair, MacBook repair, monitor repair, Windows and software support, data recovery assessment, SSD and RAM upgrades, computer home service
- Brands: HP, Dell, Lenovo, Acer, Asus, Apple, MSI
- Booking: call, WhatsApp or use the online repair form
